**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user recently attended a one-woman show at the fringe festival in early February.

[FACT] The user is currently taking a weekly acting class at a local studio.

[PREFERENCE] The user is looking for tips on how to overcome stage fright.

[PREFERENCE] The user has a tendency to overthink things.

[EVENT] The user has been working on scene study and character development in their acting class.

[CHANGE] The user has started taking a weekly acting class at a local studio.

[TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/05/20 (Sat) 15:01.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided 15 tips to help the user overcome stage fright, including acknowledging fear, preparing thoroughly, focusing on the message, visualizing success, breathing and relaxing, using positive self-talk, getting familiar with the performance space, developing a pre-performance routine, focusing on the audience, reframing thinking, getting support, practicing in front of an audience, learning to reframe nervous energy, celebrating small wins, and being kind to oneself.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained scene study as the process of analyzing and rehearsing a scene from a script, including analyzing the script, developing characters, rehearsing the scene, and getting feedback.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant described character development as creating a fully realized character, including backstory, personality, physicality, and emotional life.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for getting the most out of a scene study class, such as being open to taking risks, listening and responding truthfully, asking questions, and practicing regularly.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered tips for staying focused and present during a performance, including developing a pre-performance routine, staying in the moment, listening actively, using senses, breathing and relaxing, focusing on action, letting go of self-judgment, staying hydrated and energized, getting familiar with the space, and practicing regularly.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested exercises for staying focused and present, such as sensory exploration, body scan, and mindfulness meditation.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for dealing with negative self-talk, including recognizing and acknowledging negative thoughts, reframing them positively, practicing self-compassion, focusing on the present, and developing a growth mindset.
